title: Verify-before-application — gated change record
description: One record per change considered in a discovery flow. Captures the candidate, the RED phase (proof of need), the application step, the GREEN phase (proof of safety), and the final disposition (applied / trailed / discarded). Consumed by audit/review/refactor reporters and by kaizen-metrics to count rotting findings.

green.description: Required when disposition=applied. Optional otherwise (no GREEN if change was never applied).

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the change actually landed (applies only when disposition=applied).

demoted_reason.description: When disposition=trailed or =discarded: one-line cause (e.g. 'RED failed: 1 call site only', 'GREEN failed: regression test broke', 'out of scope: cross-module').

trail_ref.description: When disposition=trailed: backlog id, TODO marker, or issue url where the deferred item is tracked.

session_id.description: Identifier of the discovery flow that produced this record (workflow run id, audit session, etc.). Used by kaizen-metrics to group records by flow.

change_class.description: Matches the rows of the verify-before-execution RED-matrix in SKILL.md.

description.description: Free-text one-line description of what would change.

target_path.description: Primary file or directory the change would touch.

scope_loc_estimate.description: Estimated lines of code affected. boy-scout-cleanup demotes to trailed when >20.

evidence_kind.description: Type of RED evidence produced. 'other' requires a non-empty 'evidence' string explaining the kind.

evidence.description: The actual evidence: grep output, test name, citation, warning text, etc.

evidence_count.description: For count-style evidence (grep-count, call-site-count): the numeric value. For refactor-extraction the threshold is >=2.

ran_at.description: When RED was last run. Stale evidence (run before unrelated changes landed) should be re-run before applying.

passed.description: Whether the RED gate passed. false => disposition cannot be 'applied'.

surfaces.description: One entry per verification surface run after applying (compile barrier, tests, structural lint, etc.). At minimum the project's compile barrier.

passed.description: AND of all surface results. false => the change does not stand (fix or revert per SKILL.md).

command.description: Verbatim command run for this surface (e.g. 'cargo check --workspace --offline').

output_excerpt.description: Last 1-3 lines of output. Empty when passed=true; non-empty + the failure cause when passed=false.

Disposition.description: applied = both gates passed, change landed. trailed = failed gate, filed for later. discarded = failed RED with no plan to revisit (speculative / YAGNI).
